_why: Mutant ids declared BEHAVIOUR-PRESERVING or UNREACHABLE for Shutdown, each with the argument or the measurement behind it. `vit_mutate.py --equivalences` reads the KEYS of this object, so the claim and its reason live in one file. A declared mutant LEAVES THE DENOMINATOR, so every entry is a claim somebody has to be able to answer. TWELVE are declared out of 109 mutants, and NONE of them is at a statement this unit's Fortran contains: eight are at ARGUMENTS of the four LPFilter calls, where the callee's own source decides them, and four are inside the two ErrMsg helpers COPIED VERBATIM from translations/ControllerBlocks/pitchsaturation.cpp (which took them from interp1d.cpp). Every mutant on this unit's own arithmetic, indexing, comparisons and control flow -- 97 of them, including all 17 arith_op/swap_operands, all 26 negate_cond/drop_call/drop_factor/swap_call_args and 24 of 26 compare_op -- was KILLED by the 14708-case corpus.
_measurement: evidence/Shutdown/shutdown.errmsg_census_probe.cpp is the shipped translation with counters and an atexit dump added and nothing else changed, run over all 14708 harness cases. The run is GREEN (HARNESS PASS: checked 14708 failed 0), so it is a READING of the corpus and not a perturbation of it. evidence/Shutdown/errmsg_census.txt: errmsg_trim 3565 calls, assign_errmsg 3565 calls; n_ErrMsg is 7 in EVERY one of them; n_ErrMsg_cap is 4103 in every one; longest message 16; n_ErrMsg == 1 zero times; n_ErrMsg <= 0 zero times; s.size() == n_ErrMsg_cap zero times; a trailing blank inside n_ErrMsg 159 times -- which is why the `find_last_not_of(' ') + 1` mutant at the same line is KILLED rather than declared here.
04ab98e9: const_tweak '1' -> '2' at `LocalVar->restart ? 1 : 0`, the `reset` argument of the FIRST LPFilter call (SD_BlPitchF). EQUIVALENT BY THE CALLEE'S SOURCE, not by the corpus: translations/Filters/lpfilter.cpp line 40 tests `(iStatus == 0) || (reset != 0)`, and its own comment records why -- the generated Fortran wrapper hands the flag over as MERGE(1_C_INT, 0_C_INT, reset), so every non-zero value is .TRUE. 1 and 2 are both non-zero, so the two programs are the same program on every input. NO value of `restart` can distinguish them, because `restart` only selects between the two arms of the conditional and both arms are unchanged.
eb2801be: The same mutation on the `reset` argument of the SECOND LPFilter call (SD_GenSpeedF). Same reason.
1c4559b2: The same mutation on the `reset` argument of the THIRD LPFilter call (SD_NacVaneCosF). Same reason.
80d0dfbf: The same mutation on the `reset` argument of the FOURTH LPFilter call (SD_NacVaneSinF). Same reason.
08520b83: const_tweak '0.0' -> '1.0' at the LAST argument of the FIRST LPFilter call -- `InitialValue`. EQUIVALENT BY THE CALLEE'S SOURCE: lpfilter.cpp line 35 is `if (has_InitialValue) InitialValue_ = InitialValue;`, and the argument before it is the LITERAL 0 at all four of this unit's call sites, because the Fortran reference passes no InitialValue at any of them. The parameter is therefore read on no path, and the value handed to it cannot reach any output. Note the asymmetry with the four entries above: the `has_InitialValue` flag itself is NOT declared -- its `0` -> `1` mutants at all four sites are KILLED, because turning the flag on changes what the initialisation arm stores.
c9d4c359: The same mutation on the `InitialValue` argument of the SECOND LPFilter call. Same reason.
9dc1daab: The same mutation on the `InitialValue` argument of the THIRD LPFilter call. Same reason.
0828bef3: The same mutation on the `InitialValue` argument of the FOURTH LPFilter call. Same reason.
9718327c: compare_op '>' -> '>=' at `n > 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(n) : 0` in `errmsg_trim`. The two differ only at n == 0, where the tight form yields the literal 0 and the loose form yields static_cast<size_t>(0) -- the same length. EQUIVALENT ON EVERY VALUE THE C TYPE ADMITS, not merely on this corpus: interp1d's b61327db swept all 4,294,967,296 values of a 32-bit int at this identical line and reported 0 at which the view length differs (evidence/interp1d/equivalence_probe.cpp). This line is a character-for-character copy of that one -- see the header of translations/ControllerBlocks/shutdown.cpp, which records the copy -- so the proof is the same proof, cited rather than re-run because re-running an exhaustive sweep over an identical expression measures the copy and not the claim. THE SIXTH UNIT TO DECLARE THIS SITE.
e52a90b0: const_tweak '0' -> '1' at the FIRST literal of `n > 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(n) : 0`, so the test becomes `n > 1` and an ErrMsg arriving with LENGTH EXACTLY ONE would be read as empty instead of as one character. UNREACHABLE ON THIS CORPUS AND MEASURED AS SUCH: n_ErrMsg == 1 in 0 of 3565 calls, and n_ErrMsg is 7 in every one of them. THE REASON IT IS 7 IS WORTH STATING, because it is a property of the harness rather than of this unit: R13_staging_capacity and the character ladder draw ErrMsg from the reference's own character literals, and nothing in the generator puts a CHARACTER extent at 1. That is the same candidate corpus addition interp1d recorded in DECISIONS.md and did not take inside a unit -- a rung added to the character-length ladder shifts the random draws of every unit already scored -- and it is carried forward here unchanged. NOT an equivalence: at n == 1 the two programs differ, and this declaration is a statement about the corpus.
42d008e1: const_tweak '0' -> '1' at the SECOND literal of the same line, so the else-branch becomes `: 1` and an ErrMsg arriving with a NON-POSITIVE length would be read as one byte instead of none. UNREACHABLE ON THIS CORPUS AND MEASURED: n_ErrMsg <= 0 in 0 of 3565 calls. The 0 branch is the view's own NOT-ALLOCATED convention (VIT_CHAR_UNALLOCATED is -1 in vit_types.h) and the generator has no rung that puts a CHARACTER extent at its unallocated sentinel or at zero. Same site, same reason and same declaration as interp1d's 55e42d36 and PitchSaturation's 3de6b9e0.
b4ef50f9: compare_op '>' -> '>=' at `if (static_cast<int>(s.size()) > ErrVar->n_ErrMsg_cap)` in `assign_errmsg`, the refusal guard. The two forms differ on exactly one input, s.size() == n_ErrMsg_cap. MEASURED: 0 of 3565 assignments, against a capacity of 4103 in every call and a longest message of 16. THE SIXTH UNIT TO DECLARE THIS SITE -- ReadAvrSWAP e82a5f90, ExtController 11d2c9cc, UpdateZeroMQ ac7a5b72, interp1d e34d5cc4, PitchSaturation 9fb5c514 -- and the reason has not changed: the capacity is LEN(ErrMsg) + 4096 in the differential harness (harness/emit.py ALLOC_HEADROOM) and the same 4096 in the integrated build (vit_errorvariables_view.f90). WHAT IS DIFFERENT HERE, AND IS THE POINT: R13_staging_capacity IS applied to this unit's corpus -- 256 cases sweeping the headroom from 0 to 255 -- and it still does not reach the boundary, because every one of those 256 cases takes its other inputs at the BASE DRAW, where ErrVar%aviFAIL is not negative and the refusal guard is never reached at all. The census says so from the value side: n_ErrMsg_cap is 4103 in all 3565 calls that DO reach it. So the rule that exists to sweep this capacity and the arm that reads it are disjoint, and that is a finding about the instrument rather than about this translation.
_not_declared: The two threshold predicates `SD_GenSpeedF > SD_MaxGenSpd` and `ABS(SD_NacVaneF) > SD_MaxYawError` were survivors on the 11-state corpus and are NOT declared, because they were not equivalent -- they were unreached. Both compare a value this unit COMPUTES against one it is given, so R6's relational-pair rule cannot put them at equality: it needs both sides to be inputs. They are killed on the 13-state corpus by two baseline states that turn the computed side back into an input -- LPFilter's initialisation arm returns its input BIT-EXACTLY when CornerFreq is 0, where its coefficients become 2, -2, 0, 0 and the expression collapses to (1/2)*(2x). See harness/baseline.Shutdown.json. Declaring them would have recorded a corpus gap as a property of the mutants.
